committedBeforeAnyRun: 2026-10-21 — fixed before the first trend-day study run; never tuned afterwards. A change is a second, labelled study.
source: NIFTY50 daily bar (backtest cache res-D) of the session
definition: R = high - low. trend-down: (close - open) <= -bodyFraction*R AND (close - low) <= closeFraction*R. trend-up: (close - open) >= bodyFraction*R AND (high - close) <= closeFraction*R. Otherwise chop (also when R = 0).
